name: Modifiers
description: Integrates Modifier plugins into the page and into entities.

suggests.drupal/modifiers_pack: Provides a set of basic Modifier plugins (colors, background image/video, parallax, shadows, corners, etc.).
suggests.drupal/look: Provides Look entity management for applying collections of Modifiers per page.

project_description: The Modifier module defines a system for how modifications can be consistently applied to elements on a page. Modifiers leverage the Drupal theming system and abstract it into a Modifier plugin interface which applies modifications to elements defined by a CSS selector. Modifiers can be applied to entities (nodes, blocks, paragraphs, users), theme regions, view modes, Layout Builder sections/regions and WYSIWYG classes. The module itself is a foundation (plugin manager, field-to-config extraction, entity render hook) and ships no concrete plugins; useful modifiers such as colors, background images, parallax, background video, shadows and corners come from the companion Modifiers Pack module, and the Look module applies collections of modifiers per page. Maintained by Morpht.
